# Formulo syntax reference

Formulo is a deliberately small spreadsheet-expression language defined by
the resources of this sample. It is **not Excel-compatible** and **not
OpenFormula-conformant**; OpenFormula is prior art only.

## 1. Lexical structure

How source text becomes tokens. A formula begins with `=`. Whitespace (spaces
and tabs) separates tokens and is otherwise ignored. The decimal separator is
`.` and the argument separator is `,`. Function names and the keywords `TRUE`
and `FALSE` are case-insensitive and normalized to upper case; cell column
letters are normalized to upper case as well. Numeric literals keep their
spelling verbatim in the AST: Formulo assigns no numeric value to them.

## 2. Literals and references

The primary expressions: numeric literals, string literals in double quotes
with `""` as the escaped quote, the boolean keywords, cell references such as
`A1` or `$B$2`, and ranges such as `A1:B3`. A bare identifier that is not a
function call is not an expression.

## 3. Operators and precedence

Unary plus and minus, arithmetic, and comparison, with parentheses for
grouping. Precedence and associativity are declared per operator; the
productions in this chapter nest from loosest to tightest. Formulo does not
define what any operator computes.

## 4. Function calls

A call is an identifier followed by a parenthesised, comma-separated
argument list. The registry of known functions and their arities is part of
the language definition; an unknown name or a wrong argument count is a parse
error, not a runtime error.

## 5. Parse errors

The parser stops at the first error and reports its kind and byte offset.
Formulo does not attempt recovery. Every error kind is exercised by at least
one example in the conformance corpus.

## Tokens

| Token | Kind | Text or pattern |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `token-caret` | punctuator | `^` |
| `token-cell` | reference | `\$?[A-Za-z]+\$?[0-9]+` |
| `token-colon` | punctuator | `:` |
| `token-comma` | punctuator | `,` |
| `token-equal` | punctuator | `=` |
| `token-false` | keyword | `FALSE` |
| `token-greater-equal` | punctuator | `>=` |
| `token-greater` | punctuator | `>` |
| `token-identifier` | identifier | `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.]*` |
| `token-less-equal` | punctuator | `<=` |
| `token-less` | punctuator | `<` |
| `token-lparen` | punctuator | `(` |
| `token-minus` | punctuator | `-` |
| `token-not-equal` | punctuator | `<>` |
| `token-number` | literal | `[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?` |
| `token-plus` | punctuator | `+` |
| `token-rparen` | punctuator | `)` |
| `token-slash` | punctuator | `/` |
| `token-star` | punctuator | `*` |
| `token-string` | literal | `"([^"]|"")*"` |
| `token-true` | keyword | `TRUE` |

## Productions

- `production-additive`: `production-multiplicative { ( token-plus | token-minus ) production-multiplicative }`
- `production-call`: `token-identifier token-lparen [ production-comparison { token-comma production-comparison } ] token-rparen`
- `production-comparison`: `production-additive { ( token-equal | token-not-equal | token-less | token-less-equal | token-greater | token-greater-equal ) production-additive }`
- `production-formula` (start): `token-equal production-comparison`
- `production-multiplicative`: `production-power { ( token-star | token-slash ) production-power }`
- `production-power`: `production-unary [ token-caret production-power ]`
- `production-primary`: `token-number | token-string | token-true | token-false | production-reference | production-call | token-lparen production-comparison token-rparen`
- `production-reference`: `token-cell [ token-colon token-cell ]`
- `production-unary`: `( token-plus | token-minus ) production-unary | production-primary`

## Operators

| Operator | Symbol | Arity | Precedence | Associativity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `add` | `+` | binary | 2 | left |
| `divide` | `/` | binary | 3 | left |
| `equal` | `=` | binary | 1 | left |
| `greater-equal` | `>=` | binary | 1 | left |
| `greater` | `>` | binary | 1 | left |
| `less-equal` | `<=` | binary | 1 | left |
| `less` | `<` | binary | 1 | left |
| `multiply` | `*` | binary | 3 | left |
| `not-equal` | `<>` | binary | 1 | left |
| `power` | `^` | binary | 4 | right |
| `subtract` | `-` | binary | 2 | left |
| `negate` | `-` | unary | 5 | right |
| `plus` | `+` | unary | 5 | right |

## Functions

| Function | Arguments | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `IF` | 2 to 3 | A condition, a value when true, and an optional value when false. |
| `MAX` | 1 or more | Accepts one or more arguments. Variadic: no maximum. |
| `MIN` | 1 or more | Accepts one or more arguments. Variadic: no maximum. |
| `SUM` | 1 or more | Accepts one or more arguments. Variadic: no maximum. |

## Errors

| Kind | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| `InvalidCharacter` | A character that starts no token, such as `#` or `;`. |
| `MissingLeadingEquals` | The input is empty or does not begin with `=`. |
| `UnexpectedEnd` | The input ends inside an incomplete expression. |
| `UnexpectedToken` | A token appears where the grammar allows none of its kind, including a bare identifier that is not followed by `(`, and trailing input after a complete formula. |
| `UnknownFunction` | A call names a function that is not in the registry. |
| `UnterminatedString` | A string literal has no closing quote. |
| `WrongArgumentCount` | A call passes fewer or more arguments than the function accepts. |

## Examples

| Example | Source | Expected |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `example-arity-high` | `=IF(1, 2, 3, 4)` | error `WrongArgumentCount` |
| `example-arity-low` | `=IF(1)` | error `WrongArgumentCount` |
| `example-associativity` | `=8 - 3 - 2` | `(binary subtract (binary subtract (number 8) (number 3)) (number 2))` |
| `example-bare-identifier` | `=total` | error `UnexpectedToken` |
| `example-booleans` | `=true = FALSE` | `(binary equal (bool true) (bool false))` |
| `example-cells` | `=$a$1 + b2` | `(binary add (cell $A$1) (cell B2))` |
| `example-comparison-chain` | `=1 < 2 <> 3` | `(binary not-equal (binary less (number 1) (number 2)) (number 3))` |
| `example-decimal` | `=1.50 + .5` | error `InvalidCharacter` |
| `example-empty` | `(empty)` | error `MissingLeadingEquals` |
| `example-grouping` | `=(1 + 2) * 3` | `(binary multiply (binary add (number 1) (number 2)) (number 3))` |
| `example-invalid-character` | `=1 # 2` | error `InvalidCharacter` |
| `example-missing-equals` | `1 + 2` | error `MissingLeadingEquals` |
| `example-nested-calls` | `=IF(A1 > 0, MAX(A1, 1), MIN(A1, -1))` | `(call IF (binary greater (cell A1) (number 0)) (call MAX (cell A1) (number 1)) (call MIN (cell A1) (unary negate (number 1))))` |
| `example-power-right` | `=2^3^2` | `(binary power (number 2) (binary power (number 3) (number 2)))` |
| `example-precedence` | `=1 + 2 * 3` | `(binary add (number 1) (binary multiply (number 2) (number 3)))` |
| `example-range` | `=SUM(A1:B3)` | `(call SUM (range A1 B3))` |
| `example-string-escape` | `="say ""hi"""` | `(string "say \"hi\"")` |
| `example-trailing` | `=1 2` | error `UnexpectedToken` |
| `example-unary-before-power` | `=-2^2` | `(binary power (unary negate (number 2)) (number 2))` |
| `example-unclosed-group` | `=(1 + 2` | error `UnexpectedEnd` |
| `example-unexpected-end` | `=1 +` | error `UnexpectedEnd` |
| `example-unknown-function` | `=AVG(1, 2)` | error `UnknownFunction` |
| `example-unterminated` | `="abc` | error `UnterminatedString` |
| `example-whitespace` | `=  1+	2 ` | `(binary add (number 1) (number 2))` |
